sloka: अथापश्यदृशग्रीवो रौक्मं शरवणं महत् ।गभस्तिजालसंवीतं द्वितीयमिव भास्करम् ।। ७.१६.२ ॥
transliteration: athāpaśyadṛśagrīvo raukmaṁ śaravaṇaṁ mahat ।gabhastijālasaṁvītaṁ dvitīyamiva bhāskaram ।। 7.16.2 ॥

translations.english: Then Daśagrīva (Ravana) saw that great golden thicket of reeds, which was enveloped in a network of rays, appearing like a second sun.
